src='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    mid = len(grid[0]) // 2
    left = [row[:mid] for row in grid]
    right = [row[mid + 1:] for row in grid]
    left_bg = Counter(v for row in left for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    right_bg = Counter(v for row in right for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[2 if left[r][c] != left_bg or right[r][c] != right_bg else 3
             for c in range(mid)] for r in range(len(grid))]
'''
